title: This Medic Saved 75 Men Without a Gun

scenes.headline: NO GUN
scenes.text: This medic saved about seventy-five men. Without a gun.

scenes.headline: NO GUN
scenes.text: He lowered them down a cliff. One by one.

scenes.headline: OKINAWA 1945
scenes.text: May, nineteen forty-five. Okinawa. American soldiers fight for a giant cliff.

scenes.headline: NO RIFLE
scenes.text: Desmond Doss is an army medic. His faith says he must not kill. He refuses to carry a rifle.

scenes.headline: COWARD?
scenes.text: In training, other soldiers called him a coward.

scenes.headline: RETREAT
scenes.text: Then a Japanese counterattack hits the top of the cliff. The Americans pull back.

scenes.headline: HE STAYS
scenes.text: Doss stays. Under fire, he drags the wounded to the edge.

scenes.headline: ONE MORE
scenes.text: He ties each man to a rope and lowers him down. Lord, he prays, help me get one more.

scenes.headline: 75 MEN
scenes.text: By the end, he had saved about seventy-five men.

scenes.headline: MEDAL OF HONOR
scenes.text: He received the Medal of Honor. The soldier who never carried a gun.

scenes.headline: WOULD YOU?
scenes.text: Would you have stayed on that cliff?
